Both exact-head independent reviewers found the same material issue:
`native_exactness.audit_receipt_sha256` duplicates the authoritative
`EXACTNESS_AUDIT_SHA256` but is only pattern-checked in the schema and is not
revalidated by `validate_receipt()`. A caller can mutate that field, recompute
`receipt_sha256`, and still pass `--check`.

Implement the complete narrow fix:

1. In
   `data/projects/open_model_data/contracts/phase3_vspu_2025_morphemics_word_formation_candidate_v1.schema.json`,
   pin `native_exactness.audit_receipt_sha256` to the exact module constant
   `8bc0ee3dcb1d4a8f581288277666be8dbca8bda4551394365377509aa6b8f6ea`.
2. In
   `scripts/projects/open_model_data/phase3_vspu_2025_morphemics_word_formation_intake.py`,
   make `validate_receipt()` independently require that path equals
   `EXACTNESS_AUDIT_SHA256` and equals
   `bindings.exactness_audit_sha256`.
3. Extend the resealed-mutation test to mutate this twin field and prove
   rejection after recomputing the receipt self-hash.
4. Regenerate the committed public receipt through the canonical module so its
   schema/implementation/body bindings are current. Preserve the reviewed
   text-free, private-custody-only, `NARROW_ONLY`, no-closure/no-narrowing,
   Phase-3-incomplete and Phase-4-blocked semantics.

- focused VSPU tests plus the university admission/freeze/reconciliation tests;
- Ruff on the changed Python/test files;
- module `--check` on the tracked receipt;
- an explicit reseal mutation proof for the twin field.
